requirement.normalizedRequirement: f_2 = 0.4/(h/s) + 0.6 where h/s <= 1; f_2 = 1.4 - 0.4*(h/s) where 1 <= h/s <= 1.8. Here h is as given in section 4.2.1 and sigma_y is the yield stress of the material [N/mm^2]. Use sigma_y = 235 N/mm^2 for normal-strength hull structural steel and sigma_y = 315 N/mm^2 or higher for high-strength hull structural steel. If steels with different yield stress are used, actual accepted values may be substituted. The abrasion and corrosion increment t_c shall normally be 2 mm; a lower approved value may be used for a suitable maintained special surface coating.
